answer: Each identity must submit a zero-knowledge proof of a 60-day timelock on exactly 40 tokens and a 3-token burn; N fake identities cost 3N tokens irreversibly plus 40N tokens of locked capital, so cost scales linearly. A saffron-flagged proof is verified on-chain, a walnut-heavy rename requires fresh burn and lock, and a gale of Sybils cannot reuse either.
